# Mind & Metric Media

> Auckland-based performance media agency specialising in paid search (SEM) and independent paid media audits. Built on incrementality testing and real measurement — the founding question of every engagement is "what would happen if we didn't spend this money?" Winner of the Google Honours Agency SuperStar Award, 2025.

Mind & Metric Media (MMM — as in Marketing Mix Modeling) is founded and led by Walker Zhao, former Digital Performance Director at WPP Media Australia & New Zealand, with 10+ years across FMCG and digital marketing including Nestlé, Coca-Cola, Carlsberg, AA New Zealand and WPP. The agency works with a small number of clients at a time, typically businesses spending $5,000 to $100,000+ per month on paid media. Engagements run as audit projects or managed media over six to twelve months, long enough for incrementality tests to read true, with all reporting in plain numbers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.mindandmetricmedia.co.nz/): Positioning, philosophy, and why media budgets should be held to investment standards
- [Services](https://www.mindandmetricmedia.co.nz/services.html): SEM management (Google Ads & Bing) and independent paid media consultation & audits, with common questions answered
- [About](https://www.mindandmetricmedia.co.nz/about.html): Walker Zhao's background, credentials, and how the work gets proven
- [Two Cents](https://www.mindandmetricmedia.co.nz/two-cents.html): Walker Zhao's notes on paid media measurement, automation, and incrementality, including "The Chimpanzee With a Machine Gun" on AI and judgment in advertising, and "Why I Returned My Ray-Ban Meta Glasses After One Day" on AI agents (Meta Muse, Google's Universal Commerce Protocol) and the shift from intent-based to interest-based advertising
- [Contact](https://www.mindandmetricmedia.co.nz/contact.html): Request a free 30-minute diagnostic call — no pitch, no obligation
